approved_payload.content: A 31-year-old man was found stabbed to death in a street in Phase 7, a settlement in the Bloemspruit area of Bloemfontein, at about 06:00 on Sunday 4 October, after he was allegedly forced into a vehicle following an argument, according to police. Police say he had been drinking with friends when an argument broke out with a group of strangers, who allegedly forced him into a black vehicle and drove away with him; paramedics declared him dead at the scene. A task team led by Bloemspruit detectives arrested five men aged 21 to 34, who were due in court on preliminary charges of kidnapping and murder. An arrest is not a conviction. The victim and the accused are not named. Sources: SAPS Free State statement, 4 October, and NovaNews, 5 October (Lt Col Thabo Covane). The map point is an area-level point in Phase 7 (Mangaung ward 51), not the street where he was found.
